name: Starfighter
description: Ultra-light and agile craft designed for dogfights and surface-to-orbit liaisons.

name: Landing Shuttle
description: Light transport capable of landing on any terrain and docking in ship hangars.

name: Light Escort
description: Versatile starship with reinforced landing gear suitable for spaceports and solid plains.

name: Scout Ship
description: Long-range fast reconnaissance vessel capable of atmospheric landing.

name: Combat Frigate
description: Heavy line warship operating in stationary orbit. Atmospheric landing prohibited.

name: Heavy Escort
description: Armored patrol vessel too massive to withstand surface planetary gravity.

name: Star Cruiser
description: Major capital starship housing shuttle hangars and orbital bombardment batteries.

name: Fleet Battleship
description: Giant mobile fortress commanding entire stellar sectors. Strictly orbital.
